items.title: OpenAI Introduces Pando: A Git Backend That Cuts Median Push Latency ~80%
items.summary: OpenAI built Pando, a Git-compatible backend for its monorepo. It handles branches independently, reuses stored packfiles across fetches, cut median push latency by nearly 80%, and now delivers nearly a petabyte of Git data per day. The post OpenAI Introduces Pando: A Git Backend That Cuts Median Push Latency ~80% appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Zyphra AI Introduces Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA): A Path to True Subquadratic Attention
items.summary: Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA) is a tree-indexed sparse attention method that retrofits frozen LLMs with 4B tokens of distillation, matching dense attention on reasoning and 256K retrieval benchmarks. The post Zyphra AI Introduces Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA): A Path to True Subquadratic Attention appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: The Letter Company Releases Letterpress-1: A Coding Agent Built for Growth Engineering
items.summary: Letter has released the beta of Letterpress-1, a coding agent, harness and IDE for growth engineering. It reads a git-based site and its market, then opens pull requests for SEO, GEO and conversion work. The post The Letter Company Releases Letterpress-1: A Coding Agent Built for Growth Engineering appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Deep Principle Releases Hydrogen-1.0: A 753B Open-Weight Model for Scientific Discovery
items.summary: Deep Principle has released Hydrogen-1.0, an open-weight scientific model for chemistry, materials science and life sciences. It is built by post-training Z.ai’s GLM-5.3 on domain data, laboratory records and agent discovery trajectories. For developers, it offers open weights that report a FrontierScience-Research win over GPT-6-Astra. The weights ship under the MIT License. items.title: NVIDIA Releases Auto Ontology: An Open Semantic Layer That Grounds AI Agent SQL
items.summary: NVIDIA released Auto Ontology, an Apache 2.0 library that generates a semantic layer from enterprise metadata. It grounds agent SQL in certified definitions and serves context through MCP, CLI and API. The post NVIDIA Releases Auto Ontology: An Open Semantic Layer That Grounds AI Agent SQL appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Meet qwenGPU: Qwen3.5-2B With 45 Compiled GPU Layers That Run CUDA
items.summary: qwenGPU compiles a 4-lane SIMT GPU into Qwen3.5-2B as 45 untrained layers. The model writes every step of real CUDA launches itself, using Gated DeltaNet state as registers and memory. The post Meet qwenGPU: Qwen3.5-2B With 45 Compiled GPU Layers That Run CUDA appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Nace AI Open-Sources Drex Max v1: A 27B Decision Model That Runs Locally on Apple Silicon
items.summary: Nace AI open-sources Drex Max v1, a 27B multimodal decision model scoring 67.52 that runs on Apple Silicon. The post Nace AI Open-Sources Drex Max v1: A 27B Decision Model That Runs Locally on Apple Silicon appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: DeepSeek Open-Sources dsh-superagent, a Router-Worker Coding Agent
items.summary: DeepSeek released dsh-superagent, an MIT-licensed research prototype that turns GitHub and Feishu requests into parallel worker sessions. In DeepSeek’s own simulation, p95 task completion fell to 15.7 minutes from 29.5 minutes. The post DeepSeek Open-Sources dsh-superagent, a Router-Worker Coding Agent appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode
items.summary: Factory released Droid 1.0, a model-independent coding agent harness that makes programmatic tool calling the default. On Factory’s own Terminal-Bench 4 runs, Droid scores 65.2% with Claude Opus 5.5 at $4.73 per passed task. The post Meet Factory Droid 1.0: A Model-Independent Coding Agent Harness Built on Script Mode appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use
items.summary: Vercel Labs released agent-desktop, an Apache-2.0 Rust CLI that gives any AI agent computer use on macOS, Windows and Linux by reading OS accessibility trees and acting on stable refs instead of pixels. The post Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use appeared first on MarkTechPost.
